message.content:
Below is a quick reference for the **federal public holidays** in Canada for 2023 that will create “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you an extra day off).  
I’ve also highlighted which holidays fall on a weekday that would normally give you a three‑day weekend (Friday–Sunday or Thursday–Saturday) and which ones give you a four‑day weekend (Thursday–Monday or Friday–Tuesday).

| Date | Day | Holiday | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|---------------|-------|
| Jan 1 | Sun | New Year’s Day | — | No extra day |
| Feb 20 | Mon | Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, NB, PE) | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Mar 17 | Sat | St. Patrick’s Day (NB) | — | Not a federal holiday |
| Apr 7 | Fri | Good Friday | Yes | 4‑day weekend (Thu–Mon) |
| Apr 10 | Mon | Easter Monday (only federally funded employees) | — | Not a paid holiday for most workers |
| May 22 | Mon | Victoria Day | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Jun 19 | Mon | National Indigenous Peoples Day (AB, BC, MB, NL, NT, QC, YT) | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Jul 1 | Thu | Canada Day | Yes | 4‑day weekend (Thu–Mon) |
| Jul 4 | Sun | Canada Day (observed) | — | Observed on July 5 if Sunday |
| Aug 7 | Mon | Civic Holiday (most provinces except ON, QC, NB) | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Sep 18 | Mon | Labour Day | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Oct 9 | Mon | Thanksgiving | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Nov 2 | Mon | Remembrance Day | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Dec 25 | Mon | Christmas Day | Yes | 3‑day weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Dec 26 | Tue | Boxing Day | Yes | 4‑day weekend (Fri–Mon) |

### How to Use This List in Your App

1. **Create a Calendar Table** – Store each holiday as a record with fields: `date`, `name`, `province(s)` (if applicable), and `is_long_weekend` (boolean).
2. **Filter by Province** – If your users care about provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day varies by province), add a `province` field and filter accordingly.
3. **Highlight Long Weekends** – In your UI, flag rows where `is_long_weekend == true`. You could color‑code them or show a badge (“Long Weekend!”).
4. **Add Custom Logic** – Some users might consider a holiday on a Wednesday or Thursday as a “partial long weekend.” Add a rule to treat those as well if desired.

### Caveats & Further Resources

* **Provincial Variations** – The above table only lists federal holidays. Provinces may observe additional holidays (e.g., St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Natal Day in Nova Scotia, etc.). For a complete list, consult the *Government of Canada – Public Holidays* page: https://www.canada.ca/en/services/finance/public-holidays.html
* **Observance Rules** – When a holiday falls on a weekend, it is often observed on the following Monday (or previous Friday). Make sure your logic accounts for this (e.g., Canada Day on July 4, 2023 was observed on July 5).
* **Future Years** – The dates for holidays such as Easter (Good Friday) change yearly. If you plan to support future years, you’ll need a reliable algorithm or API to calculate movable feasts.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like help generating a CSV file or setting up a database schema for this data!
